query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as total_companies,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.id IN (SELECT DISTINCT companyId FROM contacts) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_contacts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.salesRepProfile IS NOT NULL AND c.salesRepProfile != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_sales_rep,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts WHERE companyId IN (SELECT id FROM companies WHERE searchId IN (1500002, 1500003))) as total_contacts,
  ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts WHERE companyId IN (SELECT id FROM companies WHERE searchId IN (1500002, 1500003))) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.id), 1) as avg_contacts_per_company
FROM companies c WHERE c.searchId IN (1500002, 1500003);
